newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Overvalued Tunis shares slumped 10 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Overvalued Tunis shares slumped 10 pct in 1996.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index lost 10 percent in 1996, reaching 570.64 points at the end of the year compared with 634.63 on January 2, 1996, bourse statistics showed.
Brokers said the market slumped because share prices had risen far too much in past years.

"In fact, the depression was expected and even wished for because the share prices had reached a level which was not matched by the financial reality of the listed firms. They were overvalued," said a broker who asked not to be named.
"For many years there was too much demand and not enough supply, the tendency has now reversed on the market," he said.
The index rose 25 percent in 1995, by 102 percent in 1994, and 26 percent in 1993. Volume traded expanded to 927 million dinars in 1995 from 531 million in 1994 and 161 million dinars in 1993.

Last year turnover shrunk 33 percent to 625 million dinars ($625 million) from 927 million dinars in 1995. The decline was even sharper on the first market where turnover fell 60 percent to 273 million dinars from 684 million dinars in 1995.
Market capitalisation eased two percent to 3.89 billion dinars, from 3.97 billion dinars in 1995.

The market depression came at the same time that the bourse was privatised, a watchdog body established, a computerised dealing system and new rules implemented to introduce more transparency to the market.
The authorities said these measures would help share prices ease to correct levels.
Thirty firms were listed on the Tunis Stock Exchange as the end of 1996, from 26 at the end of 1995.
The new listed firms are Insurance firm CARTE, detergents firm SPCD, UIB bank and chemical firm Al-Kimia.
Of all listed firms, one third saw their share prices rise while the share prices of the remaining two thirds of the firms fell.
Coke and beer bottler SFBT was down 50.8 percent. UIB bank fell 42.23 percent. Lease firm Tunisie Leasing declined 39.73 percent. Banque de Tunisie slid 34.28 percent. UBCI bank eased 28.64 percent.

Banque du Sud was up 35.94 percent but brokers cautioned that the price was not accurate as the share was not yet traded on the computerised system. Insurance firm LA CARTE rose 25 percent. Banque Nationale Agricole advanced 23.36 percent.
The index closed at 547.5 on Friday.
